Reading in the Women's data set:
```{r}
url <- "https://www.ussoccer.com/uswnt-stats/2024"
tab <- read_html(url) |>
  html_nodes("table")
womenSoccer <- tab[[1]] |> html_table()
```

Reading in the Men's data set
```{r}
url1 <- "https://www.ussoccer.com/usmnt-stats/2024"
tab1 <- read_html(url1) |>
  html_nodes("table")
menSoccer <- tab1[[1]] |> html_table()
```

1) Fix the `womenSoccer` and the `menSoccer` data set so that the first row is the variable names.

```{r}
colnames(womenSoccer) <- as.character(womenSoccer[1, ])
womenSoccer1 <- womenSoccer[-1, ]

colnames(menSoccer) <- as.character(menSoccer[1, ])
menSoccer1 <- menSoccer[-1, ]
```
